# Diagram layout

`dagre.min.js` is the browser distribution of `@dagrejs/dagre` 1.1.5,
including `@dagrejs/graphlib`. It is served locally, so diagrams do not
depend on an external CDN or service at runtime.

The upstream MIT licenses are retained in `dagre-LICENSE` and
`graphlib-LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre
